motivation: Run the cheapest informative accruals screen on repaired CVM receipt/version/unit data, without waiting for historical share counts or claiming executable total-return performance.

universe.identity: historical COTAHIST ISIN and already-public FCA; ordinary/preferred shares and units only

fundamentals: Latest already-public CVM DFP exact document version and receipt; date-only receipts usable next calendar day; monetary scales in reais. Missing newest value stays missing. No future ticker backfill.
factor: (consolidated profit - consolidated operating cash flow) / consolidated assets at year-end
selection: bottom quintile, floor(n/5), equal weight; sort accruals then ticker for ties; no sweep
target: First session open strictly after month-end signal to first session open strictly after next month-end; theoretical share-base-adjusted price return. At most 96 monthly cross-sections, 2018-02 through 2026-01 holding periods.
price_adjustments: B3 splits/groupings and stock bonuses matched to historical ISIN; quantities adjusted at ex for a theoretical price index only. Multiply simultaneous events. No inference of factors from price jumps. Legacy sourced approved adjustments only if no matching B3 event of the same type/date. Yahoo chart split events fill documented B3-history omissions as explicitly secondary, exploratory adjustments, using each event's date field (never monthly aggregation key). Cross-source discrepancies up to 0.01% relative factor are labelled rounding differences with the B3/legacy factor retained; larger conflicts are unscored. Historical-to-current source aliases require identical CVM CNPJ and unique ISIN instrument class and affect event retrieval only, never the universe.
coverage: Never remove issuers using current listing/API availability. Keep all selected rows in output. Missing endpoints, identity breaks, unsupported noncash actions, conflicting factors and unexplained >30% overnight gaps are unscored outcome cells, with explicit reasons. No silent zeros, no substitution into selected quintile. Final source collection cutoff is 2026-09-07.
metrics: monthly Spearman(-accruals, price return) on scored factor names
average monthly low-quintile minus same-factor-universe return only for fully scored cross-sections
coverage, missingness by selected/unselected names and calendar half
cost_sensitivity: Report full round-trip 36 and 72 bp haircuts to the selected-quintile mean monthly return as diagnostic hurdles only; not tax-adjusted profit or a self-financing backtest.
falsification: If any eligible cross-section is incomplete, primary status is INCONCLUSIVE_DATA_QUALITY and all available-case metrics are explicitly conditional. With complete coverage, REJECT_PRICE_SCREEN if mean IC and low-quintile differential are nonpositive in both fixed halves (2018-2021, 2022-2025); PROMISING_PRICE_SCREEN only if both metrics are positive in both halves; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE_SIGNAL. No direction reversal, window tuning or second variant after seeing results.
limitations: No dividends or JCP: bias of absolute return is generally downward, relative bias for accruals is UNKNOWN; neither a positive nor a negative result proves the total-return thesis.
Stock bonuses are theoretical ex-date price adjustments, not delivered tradable shares; no executable P&L claimed.
Available-case correlations and complete-month spreads can be selected by future data availability and cannot establish investable alpha.
CVM downloadable archives can omit superseded statement versions, producing conservative delayed availability and coverage selection.
A gap check is not a certificate of complete corporate actions; retired companies may have empty contemporary API histories.
No DSR/PBO, p-value or confirmatory verdict on this screen; no annual profit projection for R$5000 or R$10000.
canonical_proof_runners: Remain blocked; this explicit diagnostic does not silently unpause the old H17/H18/H19 configurations.
next_step_rule: Publish the first observation and all quality exclusions. Repair source errors without changing the hypothesis; any further observed result is a disclosed revision in the same search family. H18/H19 remain protected until their valuation input basis is repaired.
